mapper.select: select id, card_id, card_side, media_url, sort_order, created_at from pw_card_media where card_id = #{cardId} order by card_side asc, sort_order asc, id asc
mapper.insert: insert into pw_card_media (card_id, card_side, media_url, sort_order) values (#{cardId}, #{cardSide}, #{mediaUrl}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: select cm.id, cm.card_id, cm.card_side, cm.media_url, cm.sort_order, cm.created_at from pw_card_media cm inner join pw_card c on c.id = cm.card_id where c.deck_id = #{deckId}

select cm.id from pw_card_media cm inner join pw_card c on c.id = cm.card_id inner join pw_deck d on d.id = c.deck_id where cm.media_url = #{relativePath} and d.user_id <> #{userId} order by cm.id limit 1 for update
mapper.delete: delete from pw_card_media cm using pw_card c where c.id = cm.card_id and c.deck_id = #{deckId}
